title: Cubical Stokes for one lattice cube from a divergence representation of dγ
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, ι : Fin (m+1) → Fin P (arbitrary), b : Fin P → ℤ, and let γ be any differential m-form on Euclid P. Write e_k := EuclideanSpace.single k 1 ∈ Euclid P and toLp(b) := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun k => (b k : ℝ)) ∈ Euclid P. Put Φ(y) := toLp(b) + Σ_j y_j e_{ι(j)} for y ∈ Euclid (m+1), E := (e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(m)}) and, for i ∈ Fin (m+1), E'_i := (e_{ι(succAbove i l)})_{l ∈ Fin m}. Let G : Euclid (m+1) → Euclid (m+1) be C¹ with G(y)_i = (−1)^i γ(Φ y)(E'_i) for all y and i, and assume dγ(Φ y)(E) = trace DG(y) for all y, where d = exteriorDerivative and trace = LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m+1)). Define the front and back faces Φ¹_i(y') := toLp(b + 𝟙_{ι(i)}) + Σ_l y'_l e_{ι(succAbove i l)} and Φ⁰_i(y') := toLp(b) + Σ_l y'_l e_{ι(succAbove i l)} for y' ∈ Euclid m, where 𝟙_{ι(i)} = Pi.single (ι i) 1 ∈ ℤ^P. With Q^d the open unit cube of Euclid d: ∫_{Q^{m+1}} dγ(Φ y)(E) dy = Σ_{i ∈ Fin (m+1)} (−1)^i (∫_{Q^m} γ(Φ¹_i y')(E'_i) dy' − ∫_{Q^m} γ(Φ⁰_i y')(E'_i) dy').
